record_title: Complete cubic compensation of second-order Stuart–Landau phase corrections
provenance: A source-specific correction and coupling-design refinement for arXiv:2609.20632v1. In the paper's straight-isochrone three-oscillator Stuart–Landau setting, a resonant cubic pairwise second-harmonic monomial omitted from the displayed classification completes the cubic phase-signature basis and gives an explicit controller that cancels the full second-order phase correction.
limitations: Restricted to the explicit straight-isochrone, c=-1, identical three-oscillator, no-self-coupling reduction of arXiv:2609.20632v1 and to phase dynamics through second order. It does not cancel higher-order or amplitude corrections. General exact interaction design is established prior art; the complete proof body of Namura–Muolo–Nakao (2026) was not fully inspected, so broad phase-synthesis novelty is explicitly excluded.
